info.name: NVIDIA Run:ai Access Keys Environment API

params.name: name
params.description: Filter results by name.

params.name: scope
params.description: Filters results by scope. Returns only assets that belong to the specified scope. Mutually exclusive with includeDescendants. Valid values: tenant, cluster, department, project.

params.name: projectId
params.description: Filter results by project id. If scope filter is project, only assets from the specific project will be included in the response. Otherwise, the response will include project, department, cluster, tenant and system assets.

params.name: departmentId
params.description: Filter results by department id. If scope filter is department, only assets from the specific department will be included in the response. Otherwise, the response will include department, cluster, tenant and system assets.

params.name: clusterId
params.description: Filter results by Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) of the cluster. If scope filter is cluster, only assets from the specific cluster will be included in the response. Otherwise, the response will include cluster, tenant and system assets.

params.name: usageInfo
params.description: Whether the query should include asset usage information as part of the response.

params.name: complyToProject
params.description: Include workload creation compliance information of an asset, for a given project, as part of the response. To check compliance, you need to provide both project id and workload type.

params.name: complyToWorkloadType
params.description: Include workload creation compliance information of an asset, for a given workload type, as part of the response. To check compliance, you need to provide both project id and workload type.

params.name: distributedFramework
params.description: Filter results to workload of type distributed and distributedFramework.

params.name: isDistributed
params.description: Filter results to workload of type distributed.

params.name: isTraining
params.description: Filter results to workload of type training.

params.name: isWorkspace
params.description: Filter results to workload of type workspace.

params.name: isInference
params.description: Filter results to workload of type inference.

params.name: complyToReplicaType
params.description: Include workload creation compliance information of an asset, for a given replica type, as part of the response. To check compliance, you need to provide both project id and workload type. For distributed, replica type should be provided as well.

params.name: statusInfo
params.description: Whether the query should include asset status information as part of the response.

params.name: includeDescendants
params.description: Indicates whether to include assets from all descendant scopes under the specified scope. When set to true, and a specific scope identifier (for example, clusterId) is provided, the query also returns assets from all nested scopes within it (for example, departments and projects).  Mutually exclusive with scope.
